geocode.address: BX01 Melrose-Mott Haven-Port Morris (CD 1 Approximation), Bronx

final.paragraph:
This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and precomputed data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**In brief.**
395 flood-related 311 complaints were filed in Community District BX01 (by the record's community board field) in the last 3 years [nyc311_nta]. 6.0% is modeled to flood from rainfall in the DEP extreme scenario for 2080 sea-level rise, 1.4% is modeled to flood from rainfall in the moderate scenario for 2050 [dep_extreme_2080_nta][dep_moderate_2050_nta]. 14.1% of this area lies inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent [sandy_nta].

**Hazard Reader.**
The outline on the map is this area's boundary from the NYC Department of City Planning's 2020 Neighborhood Tabulation Areas; a community district is drawn as the union of its tabulation areas, which approximates the district [area_boundary]. 14.1% of this area lies inside the 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation extent (area 5.41 km²) [sandy_nta]. DEP Extreme Stormwater (3.66 in/hr, 2080 SLR): 6.0% of this area is modeled to flood from rainfall, 3.4% as nuisance flooding (4 in to under 1 ft) and 2.6% as deep and contiguous flooding (1 ft or more); 2.1% is in the future high tide area (coastal tidal inundation projected for 2080) [dep_extreme_2080_nta]. DEP Moderate Stormwater (2.13 in/hr, 2050 SLR): 1.4% of this area is modeled to flood from rainfall, 1.0% as nuisance flooding (4 in to under 1 ft) and 0.4% as deep and contiguous flooding (1 ft or more); 0.3% is in the future high tide area (coastal tidal inundation projected for 2050) [dep_moderate_2050_nta]. DEP Moderate Stormwater (2.13 in/hr, current SLR): 1.2% of this area is modeled to flood from rainfall, 0.8% as nuisance flooding (4 in to under 1 ft) and 0.4% as deep and contiguous flooding (1 ft or more) [dep_moderate_current_nta]. Median ground elevation 8.4 m (10th percentile 3.04 m); 26.8% of the area sits less than 1 m above the nearest drainage channel (HAND, height above nearest drainage) [microtopo_nta].

**Live Observer.**
395 NYC 311 flood-related complaints filed in Community District BX01 (by the record's community board field) in the last 3 years: 200 sewer backup, 115 catch basin, 53 street flooding, 27 manhole overflow [nyc311_nta].

**Asset Register.**
NYC Planning's Community District Profile counts 327 buildings, 1,972 residential units and 580 residents in the 1% annual chance floodplain of this district (the floodplain of FEMA's 2015 preliminary and 2007 maps; residents from the 2010 census, by census block) [dcp_floodplain_nta]. 41 MTA subway entrances in this area: 0 inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent and 6 inside the DEP extreme stormwater scenario (2080 sea-level rise). Inside the DEP extreme scenario (by station): E 149 St (6), Jackson Av (2 5) [mta_entrance_exposure]. 1 flood-exposed NYCHA development in this area (the register lists only developments found inside the 2012 Sandy extent or a DEP stormwater scenario, not every development): 0 inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent and 1 inside the DEP extreme stormwater scenario (2080 sea-level rise). Inside the DEP extreme scenario: MOORE [nycha_development_exposure]. 21 active NYC DOB construction permits inside this area since 2025-04-09: 0 inside the 2012 Sandy extent and 1 inside at least one DEP stormwater scenario (current conditions to 2080 sea-level rise) [dob_permits_nta]. 2 flood-exposed NYC DOE schools in this area (the register lists only schools found inside the 2012 Sandy extent or a DEP stormwater scenario, not every school): 1 inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent and 1 inside the DEP extreme stormwater scenario (2080 sea-level rise). Inside the 2012 Sandy extent: Success Academy Charter School - Bronx 1. Inside the DEP extreme scenario: Legacy College Preparatory [doe_school_exposure]. 1 hospital in this area: 0 inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent and 0 inside the DEP extreme stormwater scenario (2080 sea-level rise) [doh_hospital_exposure].

**Projector.**
No active NWS flood, coastal or wind alerts for this area (read at its centre), checked 2026-10-01 06:46 UTC [nws_alerts]. NPCC4 (2024) projects sea-level rise at the Battery of 0.38 m (15 in) by the 2050s and 0.79 m (31 in) by 2100 at the median, relative to 2000-2004; 90th percentile 0.74 m and 1.65 m [npcc4_slr].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
